firmStory.title: Founded on one conviction — a judgment is only as good as its execution.
paragraphs: Sridhar Lendalay began his career as a junior under Rajeev Indani, before a pivotal association with Damodar Mundra from 1997 shaped the disciplined, evidence-first approach that still defines the firm. Independent practice followed in 2005, and in 2013 he founded what is now SLA Advocates.

The firm was built around a deliberately narrow idea of success: a favourable order is only the midpoint of a matter, not its end. What began as a focused recovery and litigation practice has grown into a full-service firm — but the discipline of following a case through to actual, physical execution has never changed.

Today the firm consolidates the expertise of eleven advocates with a combined seventy-five-plus years of courtroom experience, working out of a 1,700 sq. ft. Hyderabad office built for active litigation — dedicated chambers, a conference hall, e-filing infrastructure, and legal research resources.

philosophy.title: Practical solutions, delivered with a human touch.
philosophy.statement: We aim not only to obtain favourable judicial orders, but to ensure their effective execution and real recovery.

points.title: Recovery over rhetoric
points.body: Our practice is deliberately focused on recovery matters and practical litigation outcomes. Winning an order means little without the follow-through to make it real.

points.title: Personal supervision
points.body: Every matter carries Sridhar Lendalay’s personal oversight — from strategy at intake to the final execution proceeding, with regular case follow-up and reporting.

points.title: A human touch
points.body: Celebrated for masterful cross-examination and commanding courtroom presence, Sridhar Lendalay is equally known for delivering strategic counsel with compassion — championing under-privileged clients and safeguarding their constitutional rights.

principles.title: Evidence before argument
principles.body: Every strategy is built on documentary evidence and meticulous case preparation, not courtroom theatre.

principles.title: The forum matters
principles.body: Civil Court, High Court, DRT, NCLT, Consumer Commission — the right forum, chosen deliberately, decides the case before the first hearing.

principles.title: Follow-up is not optional
principles.body: Regular case follow-up and reporting keep matters moving without the delays that quietly erode a client’s position.

principles.title: Execution is the deliverable
principles.body: We follow every order through to attachment, auction, or actual recovery — not just the judgment that precedes it.

process.title: Consultation & Assessment
process.desc: A focused 15-minute session — online or in person — where we assess the matter, the forum, and the realistic path forward.

process.title: Strategy & Documentation
process.desc: Legal notices, pleadings and case strategy are drafted with the same rigor we bring to High Court cross-examination.

process.title: Filing & Representation
process.desc: Your matter is filed and argued before the correct forum — Civil Court, High Court, DRT, NCLT or Tribunal — under Sridhar Lendalay’s personal supervision.

process.title: Execution & Recovery
process.desc: A favourable order is only half the outcome. We pursue execution and real recovery with regular case follow-up until resolution.

lines: A judgment you cannot execute is not a victory.
Thirty years does not mean thirty years of the same case.
We do not hand a matter to a junior and disappear.
Compassion is not incompatible with a commanding cross-examination.
Recovery is not the beginning of the next phase — it is the goal.

communityService.title: Constitutional rights, for those who can least afford to enforce them.
communityService.body: Profoundly aware of his social responsibilities, Sridhar Lendalay champions under-privileged individuals by safeguarding their constitutional rights — upholding the highest moral order in legal practice through compassion, integrity, and unwavering excellence.

practiceAreas.title: Civil Litigation
practiceAreas.short: Partition, injunctions, money recovery, title & possession disputes, specific performance and civil appeals.
practiceAreas.matter: Our civil litigation team represents individuals, businesses, institutions, and organizations in a wide range of disputes before Civil Courts, District Courts, High Courts, and Tribunals.
practiceAreas.approach: We assist clients in determining their exact legal position, filing the correct formal suit for the forum, and building robust strategies using documentary evidence — from partition and title disputes to money recovery and possession suits.

faq.q: How long does a typical civil recovery suit take?
faq.a: Timelines vary by forum and contested facts, but summary suits for clear-cut recovery move considerably faster than a fully contested civil trial. We assess the realistic timeline during the first consultation.

faq.q: Do you handle both filing and execution?
faq.a: Yes — our practice is deliberately built around following a matter through to execution and actual recovery, not stopping at the judgment.

practiceAreas.title: Criminal Law
practiceAreas.short: Bail applications, cheque bounce, sessions trials, FIR quashing and complete trial representation.
practiceAreas.matter: Our criminal defense team represents clients at every stage of criminal proceedings — from the first police complaint through trial, appeal, and revision.
practiceAreas.approach: We move swiftly on bail and anticipatory bail applications, build ironclad trial strategies grounded in evidence law, and use High Court inherent powers to quash vexatious FIRs where warranted.

faq.q: What is the difference between regular and anticipatory bail?
faq.a: Anticipatory bail protects a person from arrest before it happens; regular bail seeks release after arrest during an ongoing trial. We move on whichever applies to your stage of the matter.

faq.q: Can a cheque bounce complaint be settled before trial?
faq.a: Yes, many Section 138 matters resolve through settlement after the statutory notice stage. We represent both parties seeking swift, fair resolution.

practiceAreas.title: Constitutional & Writ Practice
practiceAreas.short: Writ petitions, habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari and constitutional challenges before the High Court.
practiceAreas.matter: We appear before the High Court of Telangana in constitutional matters — enforcing fundamental rights and holding public authorities accountable.
practiceAreas.approach: We draft and argue strong writ pleas to strike down unjust administrative actions, moving with urgency in habeas corpus and mandamus matters where personal liberty or statutory duty is at stake.

faq.q: When should I consider a writ petition instead of a regular suit?
faq.a: Writs are the right route when a government body or public authority has acted arbitrarily or violated a fundamental or statutory right — they move faster than ordinary civil litigation.

practiceAreas.title: Corporate & Commercial Law
practiceAreas.short: Contracts, commercial litigation, shareholder disputes, due diligence and company incorporation.
practiceAreas.matter: We support businesses across their lifecycle — from incorporation and contract drafting to high-stakes commercial litigation before specialized Commercial Courts.
practiceAreas.approach: Our focus is eliminating hidden liabilities before they become disputes: clear payment milestones, robust dispute-resolution clauses, and legal due diligence that gives buyers real negotiating leverage.

practiceAreas.title: Banking & Financial Laws
practiceAreas.short: DRT recovery, SARFAESI enforcement and NPA litigation — the core of our recovery-first practice.
practiceAreas.matter: This is where the firm’s recovery-first philosophy is most concentrated: helping banks and financial institutions convert non-performing assets into real recovery, while defending legitimate borrowers against inflated claims.
practiceAreas.approach: We combine summary suits, SARFAESI possession processes, and DRT original applications into one coordinated strategy — tracking debtor assets and pursuing corporate attachments where a simple judgment would not be enough.

faq.q: What is the advantage of SARFAESI over a civil recovery suit?
faq.a: SARFAESI lets secured lenders take possession of collateral without a full civil trial — but banks must strictly follow statutory notice timelines, which is where we ensure the process holds up under challenge.

practiceAreas.title: Insolvency & Bankruptcy (IBC)
practiceAreas.short: CIRP proceedings, creditor claims, resolution plans and liquidation before the NCLT and NCLAT.
practiceAreas.matter: We represent operational and financial creditors, corporate bidders, and personal guarantors through the full arc of the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code.
practiceAreas.approach: From drafting the statutory demand notice to defending a resolution plan before the Committee of Creditors, we handle the technical filing requirements that determine whether an insolvency plea is even admitted.

practiceAreas.title: Taxation Laws
practiceAreas.short: GST litigation, income tax appeals, TDS disputes and recovery stay orders.
practiceAreas.matter: We represent businesses through the structured appellate chain of Indian tax law — from CIT(Appeals) up to the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, and through every level of GST litigation.
practiceAreas.approach: We secure urgent stay orders against coercive recovery actions while the main tax dispute is decided, protecting cash flow while we build the substantive appeal.

practiceAreas.title: Labour & Employment Law
practiceAreas.short: Wrongful termination, industrial disputes, gratuity and PF claims, and complete labour court representation.
practiceAreas.matter: We represent both employees seeking fair compensation and employers navigating collective bargaining, disciplinary enquiries, and statutory compliance.
practiceAreas.approach: Written statements and cross-examination strategy are prepared with the same rigor as our High Court work, aimed at practical, cost-effective outcomes that protect industrial peace.

practiceAreas.title: Intellectual Property Rights
practiceAreas.short: Trademark registration and opposition, copyright protection and infringement enforcement.
practiceAreas.matter: We help clients build and defend brand portfolios — from initial trademark availability searches through opposition proceedings and infringement litigation.
practiceAreas.approach: Civil remedies to halt sales and claim damages, paired where necessary with criminal enforcement against counterfeit production, give clients the full range of protection.

practiceAreas.title: Real Estate & Infrastructure
practiceAreas.short: Title verification, sale & development deeds, RERA matters and builder disputes.
practiceAreas.matter: We guide owners, buyers, and developers through the complete real estate lifecycle — verification, documentation, registration, and dispute resolution.
practiceAreas.approach: Comprehensive title search reports protect buyers before a rupee changes hands; for disputes, we represent both individual buyers and developers before RERA and consumer forums.

practiceAreas.title: Family & Succession Matters
practiceAreas.short: Divorce, child custody, maintenance, succession planning and probate.
practiceAreas.matter: We handle matrimonial, custody, and succession matters with strategic clarity and — as our founder is known for — genuine compassion.
practiceAreas.approach: Whether mutual consent or contested, every family matter is approached to protect a client’s future well-being, not just win the immediate dispute.

practiceAreas.title: Consumer & Product Liability
practiceAreas.short: Consumer complaints, medical negligence, insurance and e-commerce disputes.
practiceAreas.matter: We represent individual consumers and housing groups before Consumer Commissions, using the framework’s simplified procedural rules to deliver faster relief than standard civil courts.
practiceAreas.approach: From preliminary legal notices through to formal claims for refunds and mental agony compensation, we build cases with the documentary and medical evidence needed to hold suppliers accountable.

team.name: Sridhar Lendalay
team.bio: Torch bearer of SLA Advocates. Celebrated for masterful High Court cross-examination, landmark recoveries, and championing under-privileged clients with compassion and integrity.
team.longBio: Sridhar Lendalay stands as Senior Advocate and Torch Bearer of SLA Advocates, commanding over thirty years of distinguished legal mastery with comprehensive litigation and advisory across civil, criminal, constitutional, corporate, banking, tax, labour, IP, real estate, family, and consumer laws. Enrolled with the Bar Council of Telangana after earning his LLB from Osmania University, he forged his expertise first as a junior under Rajeev Indani, then through pivotal association with Damodar Mundra from 1997, leading to independent practice in 2005 and founding the firm in 2013. Celebrated for masterful High Court cross-examinations that extract critical arguments, he delivers strategic oversight and landmark victories with commanding courtroom presence, while providing practical solutions infused with a human touch.

team.name: Palanati Lakshman
team.bio: Cornerstone of our litigation strength since 2012 — civil, criminal and constitutional matters across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, known for commanding courtroom presence.
team.longBio: Palanati Lakshman, Senior Advocate at SLA Advocates, commands nineteen-plus years of authoritative practice across high-stakes civil, criminal, and constitutional matters in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh courts. He launched his distinguished career at Rao and Reddy Associates in 2008 before joining SLA Advocates in 2012 as a cornerstone of the litigation strength. An expert in civil litigations spanning property disputes, commercial recovery, injunctions and contracts, as well as criminal practice including trials, bail applications, evidence handling and appeals, he is known for meticulous preparation and pragmatic solutions that blend rigorous legal analysis with client-centric advocacy.

team.name: T.V. Arvind
team.bio: Advocates’ Commissioner at Secunderabad Courts, handling civil, criminal, family and tribunal matters with deep local court mastery.
team.longBio: T.V. Arvind, Advocate at SLA Advocates with ten-plus years of proven litigation expertise, launched his career directly with the firm. Specializing in Secunderabad Courts where he serves as Advocates’ Commissioner due to his regular presence, he adeptly handles civil, criminal, family court matters, and tribunal proceedings with authoritative command. Since joining in 2015, he has delivered meticulous case management, strategic advocacy, and client-centric resolutions.

team.name: Manjula Lendalay
team.bio: Manages pleadings, day-to-day operations and client coordination with an empathetic, organised approach to case management.
team.longBio: Manjula Lendalay brings a distinctive blend of academic excellence and practical administrative expertise, holding four postgraduate degrees including M.Com, B.Ed, TET certification, and LLB. Prior to her legal career, she served as Superintendent in a Juvenile Home, honing skills in administration, counseling and conflict resolution that now strengthen her advocacy work. At the firm, she manages comprehensive drafting of pleadings, oversees day-to-day operations, and serves as the primary client coordinator.

team.name: Ashok Kumar Shetty
team.bio: Well-versed in civil trials, court representation and cross-examination, specialising in the expeditious movement of petitions.
team.longBio: Ashok is well-versed in the procedures of civil litigation, particularly in matters relating to trials, court representations, and the cross-examination of witnesses. He specializes in the expeditious movement of petitions, effective persuasion, and securing favorable disposals, ensuring timely and meaningful relief for clients.

team.name: Vinesh Lendalay
team.bio: Supports civil suits, family matters, tribunal proceedings and High Court appearances with sharp legal research and drafting.
team.longBio: Vinesh Lendalay supports the team in civil suits, family matters, tribunal proceedings, and High Court appearances, having gained practical expertise across civil courts, family courts, tribunals, and the High Court. Joining in 2023, he contributes diligent research, drafting, and client assistance.

team.name: Beemanaboina Krupakar
team.bio: Focused on gratuity matters before Labour Authorities, alongside civil, criminal and family litigation support.
team.longBio: B. Krupakar brings a dedicated and practical approach to the firm through his active involvement in gratuity-related matters, regularly representing clients before Labour Authorities and other competent forums, alongside a wide range of civil, criminal, and family matters.

team.name: Akshay Kumar Nakka
team.bio: Brings a driven, proactive mindset to drafting, research and day-to-day case management across diverse matters.
team.longBio: Akshay Kumar Nakka brings a fresh and driven perspective, having completed his legal studies at P.R.R. Law College, one of the leading law institutions in Telangana. He applies his academic training to assist with drafting, research, and day-to-day case management.

team.name: Pavan Gajjela
team.bio: Gaining structured, hands-on exposure to civil litigation, legal research and drafting under senior mentorship.
team.longBio: Pavan Gajjela is a final-year B.Com LL.B. student with a clear academic and practical interest in civil law and litigation, assisting in legal research, case briefing, drafting support, and procedural follow-ups under the mentorship of the firm’s senior advocates.

team.name: Karthik Yadav
team.bio: Involved in legal research, case preparation and streamlining office proceedings with a steady, detail-oriented approach.
team.longBio: Karthik Yadav is a dedicated member of the team with a strong grounding in core legal principles, actively involved in legal research, case preparation, and helping streamline office proceedings.

team.name: Bharath Raj Lendalay
team.bio: Blends a corporate-technical background with hands-on courtroom exposure, assisting with drafting and case coordination.
team.longBio: Bharath Raj Lendalay brings a valuable technical and management perspective, having completed his B.Tech and an MBA before officially beginning his LL.B. this year to formally step into the legal profession, currently assisting with drafting, case coordination, and operational tasks.
